description: tools/test-projects/app-lifecycle (WEB_PROJECT=app-lifecycle tools/build.sh web): S95 REQ-15 on WebGL2. Eight seconds after the page loads, it loses its WebGL context (WEBGL_lose_context) and gets it back half a second after the browser reported the loss; the engine releases its GPU objects and makes them again in the restored context, and the HTML UI document keeps the counter its script left in the DOM (7; the file says 0), loaded once. The restored context compiles every program again, which holds the page's main thread for seconds on SwiftShader: the run waits instead of sending input meanwhile.
init_script: window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('#canvas') || document.querySelector('canvas'); const gl = canvas && canvas.getContext('webgl2'); const ext = gl && gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); if (!ext) { console.error('app-lifecycle gate: no WEBGL_lose_context'); return; } canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', () => setTimeout(() => ext.restoreContext(), 500), {once: true}); ext.loseContext(); }, 8000));
